title: Summary of Concession Activities
text:
[Page 8] Summary of Concession Activities
Summary of Concession Activities
a: Exploration Licences
m Five exploration licences covering an area of 9,412.84 were granted during the year.
= Nine applications from grant of exploration licences were received during the year 2018-19.
= One bidding round was held in which ten exploration blocks were offered.
m= There were hundred and seventy three exploration licences covering an area of 320,686.64 sq. kms on 30-06-2019.
= During the year, around 5,856.71 sq. kms. Area of one exploration licences remained under Force Majeure.
= Twenty four E & P companies were active as operator in upstream Petroleum sector of Pakistan.
= In Sindh Province 80,219.00 sq. kms, Punjab 56,504.32 sq. kms, Balochistan 116,592.92 sq. kms, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa 31,668.00
sq. kms and Indus Offshore 35,702.40 sq. kms area was under exploration.
b: Mining/Development & Production Leases
m Eleven Development & Production Leases were granted covering an area of 203.89 sq. kms.
= Jen applications for grant of D & P leases were received during the fiscal year.
= Total one hundred & ninety two leases covering an area of 13,585.21sq. kms. were valid at the end of the year.
m In Sindh Province 9471.37sq. kms, Punjab 2,029.56 sq. kms, Balochistan 1078.22 sq. kms and Khyber Pakhtunkhwa
1,006.06sq. kms area remained under Mining/D & P leases.
